definition: Compound carrying the asaṅkhata headword into dhātu-language.
notes: Keep this compound aligned with the asaṅkhata headword and avoid vague metaphysical or realm-language expansion.

example_phrases.notes: Classic doctrinal expression governing the unconditioned family.

translation_policy.default_scope: Use this as the standard rendering when dhātu-language carries the asaṅkhata headword.
translation_policy.when_not_to_apply: Do not use this compound as a synonym for nibbāna, and do not expand dhātu here into realm, ground, or reality language.
translation_policy.drift_risk: Prevents the unconditioned from being restated as an eternal or transcendent place, which the asaṅkhata headword explicitly discourages.
